lang.title: Pick your language
auth.session_ended: Your session don end, so protection don pause. Sign in again make e start again.
phone.title: Your phone number
phone.help: We go send code come your Telegram make we sure say na you. We no go share your number.
phone.invalid: This no be correct phone number. Check am, try again.
otp.title: Put the 6-number code
otp.format: The code na 6 numbers. Check am, try again.
otp.invalid: That one no be the newest code. Ask Telegram for a new code and type the latest one.
contacts.title: Emergency people
contacts.help: Di pipo wey dey here na dem dey receive your alert. Dia phone dey ring and di alert no go stop until dem respond am.
contacts.invalid: Check the phone numbers. Each one must dey correct and different.
pins.title: Your safety PIN
pins.must_differ: You never share any location before. Anytime you share, e go show here.
perm.title: Make Sentri work even when phone lock
perm.battery: No let phone kill Sentri for background
home.hero: One hidden move. Your people don already sabi where you dey.
home.check_sub: Before you waka go anywhere, choose di time wey your contact dem go check on you. If you no press I dey safe before that time, alert go enter dia side.
home.check_until: If you no mark safe before {time}, alert go enter your contact dem.
triggers.title: Ways to call for help
triggers.power_note: E no dey work for every phone brand.
sos.countdown: Alert don go. To cancel: {seconds} remain.
sos.active: Alert dey active. We dey share where you dey.
sos.offline: No network. Your alert don save, e go go as network come back.
sos.responding: Person dey come help you. Stay safe.
sos.contacts_busy: One alert wey start before still dey run, so contacts no fit save for server yet. Dem save for this phone and dem go sync by demsef - you fit continue.
health.heart_none: No heart-rate source dey inside this phone yet. Connect any health app or band wey dey save heart rate to Health Connect, e go show here.
health.heart_perm: Your picture stay for dis phone. Na only your name dey go with alert.
health.heart_base: Your usual resting rate: {n} bpm. I dey watch quietly for any strange climb.
health.heart_watch: I go quietly tell you if e climb strange.
health.hr_alert_body: {n} bpm now now. Sit down rest small. If e still high after you rest, use your emergency help.
health.water_sub: Small small reminder at di pace you choose. Pick one below and di phone go handle di rest.
health.water_body: Small sips now go keep you steady for di day.
health.water_ok: Reminder don check out: every {n}, dis phone go ring am. No put Sentri inside battery saver make e still dey ring.
health.water_broken: Dis reminder no fit ring on dis phone. Pick di pace again, allow notifications, remove Sentri from battery saver.
health.hosp_error: Di map service dey slow dis time. We still dey try for background; check your data, or press Try again.
health.hosp_none: No hospital maap near you yet.
health.hosp_no_phone: No phone number dey saved on di map yet
health.heart_cam: Di app go check your heart by imsef: press your finger on top di front camera, for di top of di screen, den tap di button below. No health app dey needed.
health.measure_nofeed: Di camera no send any picture at all. Make sure your screen dey bright, you no dey call, den try again.
health.measure: Check your heart with di camera
health.measure_tip: Press your finger on top di front camera for di top of di screen until e cover am finish. Hold di phone facing you, screen bright, hand still - na di bright screen go light di reading.
health.measure_fail: Dat reading no strong enough. Press your finger wella on top di lens, sit still, try again.
health.measure_no_cam: No working camera, or camera permission no dey given. Check di camera permission and try again.
health.hosp_location: We no see where you dey yet. Turn on location, waka go outside or near window, den open dis tab again.
health.gym_none: No gym or stadium maap near you yet.
exercise.title: Exercise
exercise.sub: Walk, run or bike. Di phone count your real steps and di distance from GPS, save every session, and reward your records.
exercise.check_sub: A safety watch for di session. If you no come back and no mark yourself safe inside di time, your contact dem go get full alert.
exercise.perm_denied: Allow location (and physical activity) permission, den start again.
exercise.discard_body: Notin go save. If di safety watch dey on, e go still dey run.
exercise.history_empty: Your finished sessions go show here, each one with im route on di map.
award.shelf_hint: Badges for your records. Keep going - farther, more steps, more sessions - di shelf go full.
award.first_desc: Your first saved session. Everything start from here.
award.first_praise: Your first session! Wetin fine start!
award.km5_desc: Five kilometres altogether, waka, run or bike.
award.km5_praise: Five kilometres done! You dey move well!
award.km10_desc: Ten kilometres altogether. Your body don dey thank you.
award.km21_desc: Twenty-one kilometres altogether - half marathon on your legs.
award.km21_praise: Half marathon done! You too much!
award.steps10k_desc: Ten thousand step inside one session.
award.record_km_desc: Farther inside one go dan you ever done go before.
award.record_km_praise: New distance record! Look wetin you do!
award.record_steps_desc: More steps for one session dan ever before.
award.record_steps_praise: New steps record! Your foot dey burn fire!
award.sessions5_desc: Five session you don complete. Exercise don enta your life now.
award.sessions5_praise: Five sessions! Di habit na your own now!
map.unknown_place: We no get the place name
map.finding: We dey find where you dey...
map.route_failed: We no fit plan dis trip now. Check your data, come press Try again.
map.route_fix_gps: Wi still dey find where you dey. On your GPS, come press Try again.
map.approx_hint: Your phone dey give rough position. To get exact one: on GPS, set Sentri location to Precise, then go outside or stand near window.
map.no_location: Put location on make you see where you dey.
map.pick_hint: Press and hold any place for map.
map.nearby_none: Nothing wey dem mark dey near here.
map.search_empty: Type name of place, street or shop.
map.search_no_results: No place show. Check di spelling or try a town near you.
map.search_none_near: Dem no draw am near you on di map yet. Try di next street, or hold your finger on di map where e dey.
map.reroute_say: Hold on small — I dey find fresh road from where you dey.
map.chat_1: You dey enjoy the ride? Cool down — I sabi the road.
map.chat_2: Wetin a day, no be so? You dey try well well. Face front.
map.chat_3: I just dey check on you — you dey drive fine. I dey with you.
map.chat_4: Take small breath. I got you, every bend of the road.
map.chat_5: Nice driving. Whatever the day bring, you go handle am.
map.chat_6: You safe for this road — I go whisper the turns, you enjoy the ride.
police.note: Official Nigeria Police Force numbers for every state and FCT. If one no pick, call 112.
contacts.declined_note: Person refuse. Add another person make at least two fit help you.
contacts.load_failed: We no fit load your people. Check your network.
contacts.characters: Tap any contact give am im own name, and pick one of di 20 fine security characters. Name and character dey save for dis phone only.
inbox.title: Messages
inbox.none: Notin dey here yet. Alerts from people wey pick you go show here.
inbox.need_signin: Your session no valid again, so message no fit show. Sign in again make e show.
inbox.failed: E no load. Pull down make you try again.
inbox.scam_note: Sentri no dey ever text you alert or link. Any text wey talk say na Sentri send am na fake.
inbox.test_sent: Test don go to {n} of your contacts.
inbox.test_none: None of your contacts get Sentri yet.
inbox.test_wait: You fit send another test after few minutes.
share.title: Share location
share.help: Choose who fit follow you live. Dem go hear when you start and when you stop.
share.limit_note: Sharing go stop by itself when this time end, so e no go dey on by mistake.
share.live_note: Your contacts don hear. Dem go hear again when you stop.
share.invite_text: I add you as my emergency contact for Sentri. Install the app make I fit alert you if danger come.
share.none_reachable: None of dem get Sentri yet.
share.stop_pending: E dey stop. E go finish once network come back.
contacts.app_only: Alerts dey reach contacts inside the app with ringing notification. People wey no get Sentri no fit hear, so invite dem.
police.near_you: Call police wey dey near you
police.near_them: Call police wey dey near am
police.approx: Di police command wey near this place pass, we pick am by distance. Na Nigeria Police Force official numbers be these. If one no pick, call 112.
police.cant_dial: Phone app no open. Dial the number by hand.
police.none_found: We no see police number for this area.
police.waiting: We dey wait for location. You fit still call 112.
otp.send_failed: We no fit send the code. Check the number, try again small time.
otp.too_many: You don ask for too many codes. Try again after one hour.
otp.test_code: Test mode: your code na {code}. Tap to put am.
otp.telegram_sent: Collect your code for {phone} for Telegram.
otp.telegram_hint: For Telegram, tap Start, then tap Share my number. Your code go land for that chat. Come back here type am.
sos.police_note: You need police? Call 112 or the line wey close below.
